high.title: PII Detection in Coordination Files
high.description: PII scanner detected high-risk data exposure in coordination files with action_required flag set
high.evidence: coordination/governance/pii-incidents.jsonl shows risk_level: high with action_required: true
high.impact: Potential GDPR/privacy violation if PII is exposed in logs or coordination files
high.recommendation: Run full PII scan using lib/governance/pii-scanner.js and remediate all high-risk findings

high.title: Daemon Failures with Active Alerts
high.description: Worker daemon and PM daemon are down according to health-alerts.json
high.evidence: health-alerts.json shows two active high-severity alerts: worker_daemon_failure and pm_daemon_failure
high.impact: Reduced system availability and potential for unmonitored security events
high.recommendation: Investigate and restart failed daemons immediately. Review daemon supervisor configuration.

medium.title: Use of eval in Shell Scripts
medium.description: 6 shell scripts contain 'eval' command which can pose code injection risk
medium.evidence: Found in: auto-fix-daemon.sh, worker-checkin.sh, generate-health-report.sh, load-cache.sh, benchmark-cag.sh, em-spawning.sh
medium.impact: If user input is passed to eval without sanitization, could allow arbitrary code execution
medium.recommendation: Review all eval usage and ensure proper input validation. Replace with safer alternatives where possible.

medium.title: Governance Bypass Attempts Detected
medium.description: System attempted governance bypass which was properly denied
medium.evidence: bypass-audit.jsonl shows denied bypass attempt with GOVERNANCE_BYPASS environment variable
medium.impact: Indicates potential misconfiguration or attempted unauthorized access
medium.recommendation: Review bypass-audit.jsonl for patterns. Ensure GOVERNANCE_BYPASS is never set in production.

medium.title: API Key Exposed in Example Files
medium.impact: Low if only in example files, but should verify actual .env files are not committed
medium.recommendation: Verify .env files are in .gitignore. Add pre-commit hooks to prevent secret commits.

medium.title: Extensive Command Substitution Usage
medium.description: 2095 instances of command substitution $() across 106 shell files
medium.evidence: Widespread use of $() in shell scripts which may include unsanitized data
medium.impact: Potential for command injection if external input flows into these substitutions
medium.recommendation: Conduct code review to ensure all command substitutions use validated/sanitized inputs

low.title: chmod/chown Usage in Scripts
low.description: 3 scripts contain file permission modification commands
low.impact: Could lead to privilege escalation if misused, but appears to be legitimate operational use
low.recommendation: Review permission changes to ensure principle of least privilege

low.title: Development Mode Bypass in Auth Middleware
low.description: Authentication middleware allows unauthenticated access in development mode
low.evidence: dashboard/server/middleware/auth.js bypasses auth when NODE_ENV=development and API_KEY not set
low.impact: Development environments may be accessible without authentication
low.recommendation: Ensure NODE_ENV is always 'production' in production deployments

low.title: Compliance Test Coverage Below Target
low.description: Internal policy requires 80% test coverage but system is at 65%
low.impact: Reduced confidence in code quality and security testing
low.recommendation: Increase test coverage to meet policy requirements
